where they are found: National Government Licensed Guide Interpreter registry (JNTO-listed associations, e.g. JFG / KSGG for Kansai)
lookup_url (where to look): JNTO guide-interpreter search: https://www.japan.travel/en/plan/guide-services/  (verify); Kansai associations via that listing
outreach method: email the association; ask to circulate the Ways to earn page to Kyoto members
license / etiquette note: Licensed guides are the compliant in-person guiding role (expert catalog: in-person guiding is a provider role). Do not scrape member lists; ask the association to forward.
notes: Highest priority: the golden path's 'hand it to a local' and A6 suggestions need at least 2 approved guides with live listings.

where they are found: Kyoto City Certified Tourist Guide programme (Kyoto Convention & Visitors Bureau)
lookup_url (where to look): Kyoto CVB: https://www.kyoto.travel/en/  (guide programme page; verify path)
outreach method: contact KCVB; request introduction to certified guides interested in independent bookings
license / etiquette note: City programme; guides may be bound to KCVB booking channels. Ask before listing.

where they are found: MK Taxi / Yasaka Taxi charter desks; Kyoto Hire-Taxi Association
outreach method: direct email to charter desk; propose listing sightseeing charters as a bookable service
license / etiquette note: Charter fares are regulated; list published charter rates only. Drivers cannot be individually recruited off an operator.

where they are found: Independent photographers: Kyoto studios offering location shoots; JPS (Japan Professional Photographers Society) Kansai; Instagram location tags (manual, no scraping)
lookup_url (where to look): manual: search 'Kyoto photographer location shoot English' ; JPS: https://www.jps.gr.jp/  (Japanese)
outreach method: personal outreach by DM or email with the storefront pitch; two or three named people, not a list
license / etiquette note: No scraping of Instagram. One-to-one messages only; keep a log of who was contacted.
notes: Honeymoon / anniversary / proposal occasions all list photography in roles_needed.

where they are found: Tea ceremony, cooking class, kimono, craft workshop hosts (many already list on Viator / Klook / GetYourGuide)
lookup_url (where to look): discovery: Viator/Klook/GetYourGuide Kyoto pages (see Sources content_url)
outreach method: find hosts via partner listings, then approach them directly for a Traveloure listing at their own price
license / etiquette note: Partner listings are for discovering who exists; the Traveloure listing is theirs, priced by them. Never copy a partner listing's text.

where they are found: Restaurants that take reservations for visitors (kaiseki, izakaya with English booking); reservation platforms (TableCheck, Omakase, Pocket Concierge) as discovery only
lookup_url (where to look): discovery: https://www.tablecheck.com/en/kyoto  ; https://pocket-concierge.jp/en/  (verify) — then go direct
outreach method: approach venues directly; dining_venue listings hold a reservation policy and a price level, not a menu
license / etiquette note: Reservation platforms' terms forbid automated use; use them to find venues, then go direct. Expert nuggets carry reservation tips in plans.
notes: The 'dining' need has no content source; this is where it gets covered, one venue at a time plus expert tips.

where they are found: Golf courses within reach of Kyoto (course offices; JGTO-listed clubs); golf travel operators
lookup_url (where to look): course sites via JGA course finder: https://www.jga.or.jp/  (Japanese); Kansai course lists on golf travel operators (discovery)
outreach method: contact course offices for visitor tee-time policies; list as bookable where they allow third-party booking
license / etiquette note: Many private clubs require member introduction; list only courses that accept visitor bookings. golf-trip's primary anchor is the tee time (M7).

where they are found: Ryokan and small hotels that don't distribute through Booking.com (Kyoto Ryokan Association)
outreach method: ask the association to circulate; ryokan list rooms with tier and house rules through the property form
license / etiquette note: Properties set cancellation tier at property level (#1134). Rooms without tier inherit it.
notes: Only matters if Booking.com coverage stays thin; hotel_cache is the anchor source first.

where they are found: Hotel concierge alumni, bilingual coordinators, relocation consultants (Les Clefs d'Or Japan for introductions)
outreach method: personal introductions; this role overlaps the expert 'coordination' tier
license / etiquette note: Reservation Lifeline and done-for-you booking are expert offerings; in-person accompaniment is a provider role. Point people to the right door.
Blue Badge is the recognised standard; ask the STGA to forward.

where they are found: Licensed guides via Turismo de Portugal registry (RNAAT operators; guia-intérprete)
outreach method: contact registered operators; individual guides via AGIC (Portuguese guides association)
license / etiquette note: RNAAT registration is the compliance marker for activity operators.

where they are found: Registro Nacional de Turismo (RNT) guides; Bogotá guide associations
license / etiquette note: RNT is mandatory for tourism services in Colombia; list only RNT-registered providers.

where they are found: RNT-registered guides and boat operators (Corporación Turismo Cartagena)
license / etiquette note: RNT required. Boat trips to the islands are a transport + activity combination.

where they are found: Ministry of Tourism Regional Level Guides (RLG) / IITFC-certified guides; state tourism guide lists
lookup_url (where to look): Ministry of Tourism guide programme: https://tourism.gov.in/  (RLG / IITFC pages; verify)
outreach method: contact via state tourism offices and guide associations
license / etiquette note: Certified-guide lists exist per state; ask the office to circulate rather than copying lists.

where they are found: Tourist-permit car operators (state tourism approved); Goa taxi associations
lookup_url (where to look): state tourism offices; Goa: https://goa-tourism.com/  (approved operators section; verify)
outreach method: direct to operators with tourist permits
license / etiquette note: List operators, not individual drivers; tourist permit required.

where they are found: Local photographer associations; wedding/photo studios listed on partner sites (discovery only)
outreach method: personal outreach, two or three per market

role (roles_needed key): event_coordinator, caterer, florist, av_tech, rentals, venue
where they are found: Wedding/event vendor directories (discovery only), venue sales offices, hotel banquet teams
outreach method: direct outreach; venues first, vendors via venues
license / etiquette note: Directories' terms forbid automated use; use for discovery, go direct. Hosted events and Celebrations groups are Track B.
notes: Template row per market; not needed for the Kyoto Trips slice.
